text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro-driverless thesis and safety claim","quality":"positioning","description":"The essay states a definite stance early and keeps that stance visible throughout the piece."},{"evidence":"mentions BMW Traffic Jam Assistant and Google's LIDAR","quality":"text-based support","description":"The essay uses specific details from the source article to back up its claims rather than relying only on general opinions."},{"evidence":"explains fewer crashes, drunk/texting drivers, pedestrian safety","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay develops its reasons with more explanation of how driverless cars would improve safety for different people."},{"evidence":"raises liability and then answers it with speed limit and manufacturer responsibility","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges a major objection and attempts to respond to it instead of just ignoring it."},{"evidence":"uses transition phrases like 'And this would be great but there is one problem'","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly arranged into introduction, body, rebuttal, and conclusion."}]}
